# Results tables (generated by `uv run steering-explainer --phases tables`; do not edit by hand)

Pilot (N = 20): mean steer(5) − random(5) = +0.135, d_z = 0.633, required N for 80% power = 22, chosen N = 30.
'lov…'/'hate' shares are post-hoc (exploratory, not pre-registered): fraction of completions matching `lov` / `hat(e|ing|red)`, averaged per prompt.
